subscription_strategy.principle: Flat Max/Ultra/Heavy subscriptions are capacity pools. Consume them on bounded deliverables, not duplicated analysis or synthetic token burn.

anthropic-claude-max.primary: deep multi-file backend implementation and architecture review

gemini-ultra.primary: long-context repository mapping, research synthesis, visual review

xai-heavy.primary: Hermes Queen orchestration, adversarial challenge, current web/X research, media

orchestration.why: Queen judgment, owner assignment, conflict resolution, and concise delivery reporting

deep-backend.why: Deep multi-file backend reasoning and autonomous TDD loops on a single owned worktree

refactor.why: Fast implementation, local verification, and bounded batch fixes

independent-review.why: Second-agent review against tests, diff, security, and integration contract

long-context.why: Long-context repository mapping before focused implementation

research.why: Current web/X research and adversarial synthesis with citations

low-stakes.why: Use paid flat subscription capacity for useful small fixes; do not route to an unauthenticated free lane

ui.why: YogaBook-owned frontend implementation with local browser verification

repo-ops.why: Deterministic issue, PR, CI, and repository operations

infra.why: Queen plus domain skills for gated infrastructure operations
